title: EU harmonised list of supporting documents for applicants in Tunisia — C(2019) 3271, Annex VI

facts.statement: All applicants: a round-trip reservation or ticket.
All applicants: proof of accommodation (host company, hotel reservation or enough money, private host covering costs, or rental/ownership).
facts.quote: A hotel reservation, or proof of sufficient means to cover accommodation; or Confirmation of private accommodation, stating that the costs will be covered by the host

facts.statement: All applicants: bank account statements for the last three months.
facts.quote: Bank account statements for the last three months

facts.statement: If someone else pays: proof that costs are covered by the inviting organisation or a private sponsor, with the sponsor's means.
facts.quote: Costs being covered by a private individual (and proof of the sponsors means)

facts.statement: Other accepted means: international credit card statements, the tourist allowance, etc.
facts.quote: Other financial means available during the visit (international credit card statements, touristic allowance, etc.).

facts.statement: Employees: employment certificate or recent contract, pay slips for the last three months, CNSS affiliation certificate, and leave / duty-travel authorisation from the employer.
facts.quote: Employees: certificate of employment or recent employment contract and pay slips for the last three months, certificate of affiliation to the national social security scheme (CNSS)

facts.statement: Farmers: proof of status, farmer's card and latest annual income declaration or property title.
facts.quote: Farmers: proof of status, farmer’s card and most recent declaration of annual income or title of property;

facts.statement: Pensioners: proof of receiving a pension.
facts.quote: Pensioners: proof of receipt of a retirement pension;

facts.statement: Students: proof of the parents' social or employment status and a school attendance certificate or student card.
facts.quote: Students: evidence of the parents’ social or employment status and, where applicable, school attendance certificate or student card.

facts.statement: Minors travelling alone or with one parent: written consent of the parents / legal guardians (unless the parent has sole custody).
facts.quote: The written consent of the parents/legal guardians should be required only if the minor travels alone or only with one parent.

facts.statement: Business trip: invitation letter from a company in the destination state (names, purpose, length, funding) and proof of the business relationship.
facts.quote: Invitation letter from a company in the Member State of destination indicating the name(s) and surname(s) of the person(s) invited, the purpose of the trip, the length of the stay

facts.statement: Family or private visit: invitation from the host and, for family, proof of family ties (e.g. fiche familiale d'état civil).
facts.quote: For a family visit: proof of family ties (e.g. a family record from the register office).

facts.statement: Tourism: hotel reservation, or proof of rental or ownership of property at destination.
facts.quote: Hotel reservation; or Proof of rental or ownership of property in the country of destination.

facts.statement: Cultural, sports, educational, research or training trip: invitation from the organiser and an official letter from the Tunisian ministry or entity concerned.
facts.quote: Letter of invitation or official document from the organiser of the cultural, sports, educational, research or vocational training event

facts.statement: Medical treatment: doctor's certificate, confirmation from the host medical institution, and proof of prepaid treatment or insurance.
facts.quote: Official document from the host medical institution confirming that it can provide the medical treatment in question and that the patient will be accepted.
